Mission Statement

KC 360 Photo booth LLC gives you a Photo booth experience that your guest can't forget.

KC Photo Booth LLC is a NYC based Photo Booth company that specializes in making memorable memories at your special event. Because when we come in the room everyone gets excited. KC photo Booth LLC is  want and need at your next wedding, party or corporate event.
